source_origin: Signed Linux 7.3.1 and the exact release 115 source composition. Candidate 116 retains its four-channel audio, 122 adaptation patches and startup fixes, and adds reviewed CPUFreq boost error recovery, LMH policy lifecycle, manual GET-only CPUCP observation and guarded retirement of an unused clock measurement client. All three ignore-unused parameters remain. Physical acceptance is pending.
